description: This Python script defines hooks and utility functions for customizing MkDocs static site generation, especially handling multilingual content, file resolution, and navigation structure adjustments.

classes.name: EnFile
classes.description: A subclass of mkdocs.structure.files.File, possibly for extensions or customizations.

methods.name: MkDocsConfig on_config(config: MkDocsConfig, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Adjusts the MkDocs configuration, setting the language and site URL based on directory name.

methods.name: None resolve_file(*, item: str, files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Resolves a file item, potentially mapping to a different language directory if not found.

methods.name: None resolve_files(*, items: list[Any], files: Files, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Resolves multiple files given a list, handling nested lists and dicts.

methods.name: Files on_files(files: Files, *, config: MkDocsConfig)
methods.description: Processes the files in the build, resolving theme assets, extra CSS, and JavaScript.

methods.name: list[Union[Page,Section,Link]] generate_renamed_section_items( items: list[Union[Page, Section, Link]], *, config: MkDocsConfig )
methods.description: Recursively adjusts section titles and children for navigation structure.

methods.name: Navigation on_nav( nav: Navigation, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files, **kwargs: Any )
Page on_pre_page(page: Page, *, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files)
methods.description: A placeholder hook executed before page processing.

methods.name: str on_page_markdown( markdown: str, *, page: Page, config: MkDocsConfig, files: Files )
methods.description: Modifies the markdown content of a page, adding missing translation notices and metadata.

methods.name: str get_missing_translation_content(docs_dir: str)
methods.description: Caches and returns the content for missing translations.

methods.name: list[str] get_mkdocs_material_langs()
methods.description: Caches and returns available language codes for the Material theme.
